name: Erin C. Degroot
office: Wrightwood Community Services District, Member, Board of Directors

items.text: Erin C. DeGroot is vice president of the Wrightwood Community Services District board. Appointed in May 2025, she previously served as the district's Parks and Recreation Coordinator. After public fund discrepancies, she supported an independent financial review and the board did not renew the general manager's contract. She says she wrote the board's demand for an environmental impact report on the Lone Pine Canyon Quarry and supports new parks.
